reasoning: On the season so far the Warriors are the stronger team; with home court the Warriors start about 4 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Clippers (revenge).
Bottom line: the Warriors win 62 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.
